{{Quote|A spy has obtained records from a Mos Eisley repository owned by Jabba the Hutt. Jabba stole the records long ago from a rival Hutt crimelord. Now the Hutts are after my spy. Can you bring her here?|[[Rakir Banai]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RB" />}}
'''Deela Quellor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jabba stole these records long ago from a rival Hutt crimelord, Gardulla. Rakir will find them very interesting. Please take me to him.|Deela Quellor, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RB" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Deela Quellor obtained records from a [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] repository owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. The records was in fact stolen long ago by Jabba from his rival [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]. After the theft, Jabba sent henchmen to kill Deela and retrieve the data.<ref name="SWG:RB" />

In the meantime, the man known as [[Rakir Banai]] was looking for information about the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to find his long missing son, [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster]]. Rakir tasked the spacer to find Deela Quellor and escort her back to him. The spacer finally find Deela and saved her from Jabba's henchmen. The spacer and the woman returned safely to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] with and Gardulla's records. From the records, Rakir Banai understood that his son was alive and living on Tatooine, an information deliberately concealed by his boss [[Drik Bandrik]].<ref name="SWG:RB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateEntertainer.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Deela Quellor, including one male depiction deemed non-canon in ''Legends'']]
Deela Quellor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:RB" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Due to the nature of many older [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] of Quellor changed each time a player performed this quest. Under her spawn template, she would either appear as a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|haired]], [[brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] female, a yellow eyed female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], or a male Twi'lek. Therefore, from an [[in-universe]] perspective, Quellor could have either been a Human or a Twi'lek. The quest dialogue given by Rakir Banai also indicated that Quellor was a female.<ref name="SWG:RB" />

Furthermore, although not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining her revealed her to be an [[entertainer]]. However, it should be noted that this was primarily due to game mechanics, as a result of Quellor being placed under the randomized entertainer spawn template appearance.<ref name="SWG:RB" />
